and m.menu_sj like concat('%', #{query}, '%')
and m.menu_cn like concat('%', #{query}, '%')
and DATE_FORMAT(frst_regist_pnttm,'%Y%m%d') BETWEEN #{startCreateDate} AND #{endCreateDate}

SELECT A.mnl_sn , A.detail as page_gbn , A.menu_sj , A.frst_register_id , (SELECT crypto_dec('normal', MGR.user_name, '', 0) FROM op_manager MGR WHERE user_id = A.frst_register_id) AS user_name , A.inqire_co , A.frst_regist_pnttm FROM ( SELECT M.mnl_sn , C.detail , M.menu_sj , M.frst_register_id , M.inqire_co , DATE_FORMAT(M.frst_regist_pnttm,'%Y-%m-%d') AS frst_regist_pnttm FROM g_mnl M, op_common_code C WHERE 1=1 AND M.menu_se_code = C.id AND C.code_type = 'MENU_URL' AND C.use_yn = 'Y'
AND C.detail LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%')
AND M.menu_sj LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%')
AND M.menu_cn LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%')
AND DATE_FORMAT(frst_regist_pnttm,'%Y%m%d') BETWEEN #{startCreateDate} AND #{endCreateDate}
ORDER BY frst_regist_pnttm DESC ) A
